fix_validation.issue: Model expanded an explicit end date to 00:24 despite prompt-only correction.
fix_validation.fix: Bind recognized explicit ISO date ranges in tool schema and reject mismatches before SQL, with bounded correction feedback.
fix_validation.proof: Regression demonstrated failure before fix; 73 tests and final full live run pass.

limitations: Single-operator local application; no enterprise authentication or OS-account sandbox.
State is in memory; evidence files do not restore authorization after restart.
Explicit window binding recognizes two ISO inclusive-to/through-exclusive ranges and a named timezone; other wording remains model-interpreted with visible bounds.
SQL budget excludes metadata authorization round trips and rollback cleanup.
Lifecycle/order/retry/settlement/health metrics, durable checkpoints and adaptive multi-bundle investigations remain deferred.
historical_reports: Earlier socket, occupied-port, window-drift and temporary-directory failures are preserved; they are superseded by the linked final runs.
